tools.name: imagekit_list_files
tools.description: List or search files and folders in the media library, with name, path, tags, size, dimensions and URLs. Use searchQuery for filters such as name, tags or path (for example: 'tags IN ["sale"] AND createdAt > "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"'). ImageKit API: GET /v1/files.

tools.name: imagekit_get_file
tools.description: Get one file or folder: name, path, tags, custom metadata, dimensions, size, URL and publication status. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/{fileId}/details.

tools.name: imagekit_get_file_metadata
tools.description: Get the EXIF, IPTC, XMP and technical metadata of one uploaded file. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/{fileId}/metadata.

tools.name: imagekit_get_metadata_from_url
tools.description: Read the image metadata of a publicly reachable image URL without uploading it to the media library. ImageKit API: GET /v1/metadata?url=.

tools.name: imagekit_list_file_versions
tools.description: List the earlier versions of one file. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/{fileId}/versions.

tools.name: imagekit_list_custom_metadata_fields
tools.description: List the custom metadata fields defined for the account, with their types. Use the field names in imagekit_list_files searches. ImageKit API: GET /v1/customMetadataFields.

tools.name: imagekit_get_usage
tools.description: Get bandwidth, storage, transformation and request usage for a date range. Needs a restricted key with account read access (standard keys do not include account management). ImageKit API: GET /v1/accounts/usage.

tools.name: imagekit_get_bulk_job_status
tools.description: Check a bulk job, such as a folder copy or move, by its jobId. ImageKit API: GET /v1/bulkJobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: imagekit_get_purge_status
tools.description: Check a CDN cache purge request by its requestId. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/purge/{requestId}.

tools.name: imagekit_upload_file
tools.description: Upload an image or file to the media library from a public URL or a base64 string. Creates a new file each call (it does not overwrite by default). Upload host: POST https://upload.imagekit.io/api/v1/files/upload.

tools.name: imagekit_update_file_details
tools.description: Replace the tags of one file, or publish or unpublish it. Tags sent here replace the existing tags. ImageKit API: PATCH /v1/files/{fileId}/details.

tools.name: imagekit_add_tags
tools.description: Add tags to several files at once. Existing tags stay. Adding a tag twice has no extra effect. ImageKit API: POST /v1/files/addTags.

tools.name: imagekit_remove_tags
tools.description: Remove tags from several files at once. Tags that are not present have no effect. ImageKit API: POST /v1/files/removeTags.

tools.name: imagekit_move_file
tools.description: Move one file to another folder. The file path changes, so existing links to the old path stop working. ImageKit API: POST /v1/files/move.

tools.name: imagekit_rename_file
tools.description: Rename one file. The file path changes, so existing links to the old name stop working. ImageKit API: PUT /v1/files/rename.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: imagekit_list_files, imagekit_get_file, imagekit_get_metadata_from_url · Private data: imagekit_list_files, imagekit_get_file, imagekit_get_file_metadata, imagekit_list_file_versions, imagekit_get_purge_status, imagekit_upload_file, imagekit_update_file_details, imagekit_add_tags, imagekit_remove_tags, imagekit_move_file, imagekit_rename_file · Public sink: imagekit_upload_file, imagekit_update_file_details, imagekit_add_tags, imagekit_remove_tags, imagekit_move_file · Destructive: imagekit_upload_file, imagekit_remove_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: imagekit_list_files, imagekit_get_file, imagekit_get_metadata_from_url · Private data: imagekit_list_files, imagekit_get_file, imagekit_get_file_metadata, imagekit_list_file_versions, imagekit_get_purge_status, imagekit_upload_file, imagekit_update_file_details, imagekit_add_tags, imagekit_remove_tags, imagekit_move_file, imagekit_rename_file · Public sink: imagekit_upload_file, imagekit_update_file_details, imagekit_add_tags, imagekit_remove_tags, imagekit_move_file · Destructive: imagekit_upload_file, imagekit_remove_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
